posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
It is definitely our intention to post official rulings on all of the questions people have posed on this forum! I would like to thank Andy in particular for compiling all such questions in a convenient format. Unfortunately, we have gotten *extremely* behind in responding to these questions, owing primarilly to the combined crazy-business involved in Vengeance, GSF, the warehouse move, and now the start of the convention season. However, we hope to get to them soon! Perhaps a series of giant super-long plane trips to and from Australia will help...

 

In any case, I just wanted to let you all know that we appreciate the questions, and will endevor to catch up with responses, and respond more promptly going forward. Stay tuned!

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: Once you post official rulings to those questions, I'll add them to my FAQ, but do you guys have any plans for dealing with the largish set of FAQ-worthy information in general?  By that I mean, are you planning on updating cards in a new printing with new wording that would remove the need for some of the clarifications in the FAQ, or are you planning on producing an official FAQ of your own?  Or are you guys relatively comfortable with the way we've been handling things so far?

posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
We are relativly comofortable with the way you've been handling things thus far since, while there are quite a number of "official ruling" clarifications, they are not generally required by players for the game to be enjoyed. However, we would love to create an official "FAQ" at some point, but it is below all of the items on the "List of Thing To Do" that involve "Stabilizing GTG as a Real Company" :)

 

In the mean time, I definitely want to thank you for all of your help compiling and sharing the answers to such questions! We really appreciate it!
